target.role: Senior Director, Funding and Liquidity Risk Management

summary: Senior Director, Funding and Liquidity Risk Management candidate with ~7 years across liquidity risk, ALM, and balance-sheet risk for pension funds, insurers, and institutional asset managers. At Moody's Analytics holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ($5–25bn per engagement; ~$50bn+ cumulative), and led design of a multi-scenario cash-flow projection and liquidity-gap engine. Prior advisory at EY (IFRS 9/17 regulatory transformation) and Ortec Finance (stochastic ALM, LDI, stress testing). CFA charterholder; dual MSc (Financial Modelling; Chemical Engineering).
core_skills: Second Line of Defense — Effective Challenge & Governance

sections.heading: Liquidity Risk, Funding & Cash-Flow Projection
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios — delivering forward-looking liquidity visibility across ALM horizons.

Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year), enabling funding optimization, refinancing risk assessment, and asset-allocation decisions; designed to align with regulatory liquidity expectations analogous to those in OSFI LAR.
Embedded behavioral cash-flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays consistent with regulatory contingency funding planning expectations.

sections.heading: Balance Sheet, Market Risk & Derivatives Review
bullets: Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ranging $5–25bn per engagement (cumulatively ~$50bn+ across the book of work).
Oversees interest-rate risk and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, applying standards analogous to Basel IRRBB frameworks.
Reviews and validates derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, checking sensitivity consistency at portfolio-level ALM aggregates.

sections.heading: Second Line of Defense — Effective Challenge & Stakeholder Reporting
bullets: Operates within a formal model-governance framework as a second line of defense function: independently reviews curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.

Escalates outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility; serves as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing directly with clients' Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.

Prepares stakeholder reporting on interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities for senior audiences — translating quantitative outputs into executive-ready risk narratives.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms on the PFaroe analytics platform; advised on asset, liability, and ALM configurations and validated model outputs post-deployment.

Served as technical liaison between client investment teams and product/development, translating requirements into structured Product Owner requests; successfully migrated all assigned client accounts from legacy Calypso to PFaroe PM.

roles.title: Senior Consultant — IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Advised actuarial, IT, finance, and program-management functions on standard adoption; contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes across cross-functional teams.
Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors, analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk exposures.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.
Performed cash-flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk for international institutional clients.

Conducted liability-driven investment (LDI) analysis and advised on Strategic and Tactical Asset Allocation trade-offs via stress testing and sensitivity analysis; presented findings to pension-fund investment committees.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) — Western University, 2016
